members.name: tweet_hate_v6
members.instructions: Under a hate speech annotation policy, a tweet is hateful if its own text is hostile to immigrants/refugees as people or calls for their exclusion (invasion or crime-by-immigrants framing, riots or violence, 'send them home', 'no illegals', a very short approving tweet made mostly of exclusion hashtags), or if it expresses strong hostility toward women (threats, sexual degradation or violence, angry name-calling with stacked slurs such as 'you fucking bitch, you fucking whore', shaming generalisations such as 'rat hoe', contempt for women as a group). It is NOT hateful when the body complains about or attacks Democrats, liberals, politicians, activists, voters, 'traitors' or others and immigration hashtags such as #StopTheInvasion or #sendthemhome are merely appended, when immigration, crime news or policy is just discussed or the term 'illegal aliens' is trended, or when slang such as bitch/hoe/whore is used in banter, an ordinary quarrel, gossip, a single casual insult, or self-referentially. Which description best fits this tweet?

criteria.immigrants_dehumanizing: Text hostile to immigrants, refugees, illegal aliens or a nationality/religion group as people: insults, dehumanising, blaming them as a group for crime, fraud, disease or for sucking money/welfare/jobs out of the country (scum, criminals, rapists, invaders, parasites, lazy, burden on taxpayers)
criteria.immigrants_expel_or_harm: Calls for immigrants/refugees to be deported, sent back/home, kept out ('no illegals'), or harmed, or refers to riots/violence against them, with a hostile tone toward them as people
criteria.stop_immigration_slogan: A very short tweet that is mostly exclusion hashtags or a bare demand to stop immigration or deport them ('StopImmigration', '#DeportThemAll', '#NoIllegals #NoChainMigration', mocking 'precious illegal aliens! #DeportThemAll')
criteria.women_direct_attack: Strong hostility toward women: threats, sexual degradation or sexual violence, angry name-calling with stacked slurs ('You fucking bitch! You fucking whore!'), shaming generalisations about women as sluts ('rat hoe', 'bitches be selling they body'), an enraged sustained attack on a woman
criteria.other_slur_hate: Hateful slurs or hostility against another protected group (race, religion, ethnicity)
criteria.immigration_policy_neutral: Discusses immigration, the border, a wall, wall funding, deportation policy, demographics or crime news (even crimes by named immigrants) without hostility toward immigrants as a group; trending/defending the term 'illegal aliens', bare hashtags, calls to trend, spam, news, opinion on policy
criteria.attack_on_non_target: The body complains about or attacks Democrats, liberals, politicians, activists, voters, 'traitors', parties, the media, celebrities or others who are not women or immigrants as such, with immigration hashtags (#StopTheInvasion, #sendthemhome) or words like 'rapefugee' appended or aimed at politicians
criteria.casual_slang: Words like bitch, hoe, slut used casually, jokingly, affectionately, proudly or self-referentially; to a friend or man; in an ordinary quarrel, a single casual insult, gossip or banter; song lyrics, quotes
